"""Entry point of the API: run it with "uvicorn app.main:app --reload"."""

from fastapi import FastAPI

from app.errors import register_error_handlers
from app.routers.category import router as category_router
from app.routers.item import router as item_router


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    """Builds the application: error format, storage and the routes of every resource."""
    app = FastAPI(
        title="catalog-api",
        version="0.1.0",
        description="REST API generated by Model2API. Review it before using it in production.",
    )
    register_error_handlers(app)
    app.include_router(category_router)
    app.include_router(item_router)
    return app


app = create_app()

"""Request and response schemas of categories."""

from typing import ClassVar

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.validators import ApiModel, ResponseModel


class CategoryCreate(ApiModel):
    """Body of a request that creates or replaces a category."""

    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)
    parent_id: int | None = Field(default=None, alias="parentId")


class CategoryUpdate(ApiModel):
    """Body of a request that changes part of a category: only the fields sent change."""

    name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=80)
    parent_id: int | None = Field(default=None, alias="parentId")

    non_nullable: ClassVar[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"name"})


class Category(ResponseModel):
    """A category as the API returns it."""

    id: int
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)
    parent_id: int | None = Field(default=None, alias="parentId")


class CategoryPage(BaseModel):
    """One page of categories."""

    items: list[Category]
    total: int
    page: int
    size: int

"""Request and response schemas of items."""

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import ClassVar

from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, Field

from app.validators import ApiModel, DecimalNumber, ResponseModel


class ItemCreate(ApiModel):
    """Body of a request that creates or replaces an item."""

    name: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=120)
    price: DecimalNumber = Field(..., ge=0)
    supplier_email: EmailStr = Field(..., alias="supplierEmail")
    category_id: int = Field(..., alias="categoryId")
    stock: int = Field(..., ge=0)


class ItemUpdate(ApiModel):
    """Body of a request that changes part of an item: only the fields sent change."""

    name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=3, max_length=120)
    price: DecimalNumber | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    supplier_email: EmailStr | None = Field(default=None, alias="supplierEmail")
    category_id: int | None = Field(default=None, alias="categoryId")
    stock: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)

    non_nullable: ClassVar[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"name", "price", "supplier_email", "category_id", "stock"})


class Item(ResponseModel):
    """An item as the API returns it."""

    id: int
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=120)
    price: DecimalNumber = Field(..., ge=0)
    supplier_email: EmailStr = Field(..., alias="supplierEmail")
    category_id: int = Field(..., alias="categoryId")
    stock: int = Field(..., ge=0)


class ItemPage(BaseModel):
    """One page of items."""

    items: list[Item]
    total: int
    page: int
    size: int

"""API key authentication: the key in the X-API-Key header must be one of API_KEYS."""

from secrets import compare_digest

from fastapi import Security
from fastapi.security import APIKeyHeader

from app.config import get_settings
from app.errors import UnauthorizedError

_api_key = APIKeyHeader(name="X-API-Key", auto_error=False, scheme_name="apiKey")


def require_api_key(key: str | None = Security(_api_key)) -> None:
    """Lets the request through only with a configured key. Without API_KEYS, every request is rejected."""
    keys = get_settings().api_keys
    if not key or not any(compare_digest(key, valid) for valid in keys):
        raise UnauthorizedError()

# catalog-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with FastAPI. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Python 3.11 or later.

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate        # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
cp .env.example .env             # then fill in your values
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --env-file .env
```

The interactive documentation is at http://localhost:8000/docs, and the contract in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
pytest
```

The tests call every endpoint with an empty storage.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/categories` | List categories | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/categories/{id}` | Get a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/categories` | Create a category | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/categories/{id}` | Replace a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/categories/{id}` | Update part of a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/categories/{id}` | Delete a category | 204 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/items` | List items | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/items/{id}` | Get an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/items` | Create an item | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/items/{id}` | Replace an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/items/{id}` | Update part of an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/items/{id}` | Delete an item | 204 | authenticated |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

Storage is left to you: each repository is an interface with methods to implement, and the API answers 501 until they are.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints need a key in the `X-API-Key` header, one of the comma-separated keys in `API_KEYS`. Without `API_KEYS`, every protected request is rejected.

## Structure

```text
app/
  main.py, config.py, errors.py, dependencies.py, validators.py
  schemas/              request and response schemas
  repositories/         storage
  services/             rules of each resource
  routers/              HTTP routes
tests/                  one test file per resource
openapi.yaml            the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- Storage: every repository in `app/` answers 501 until you write it (search for `TODO`).

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


def test_list_categories_storage_is_pending(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    response = client.get("/categories", headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 501
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "not_implemented"


def test_get_category_storage_is_pending(client: TestClient, headers: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    response = client.get("/categories/999999", headers=headers)
    assert response.status_code == 501
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "not_implemented"


def test_list_categories_needs_credentials(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.get("/categories")
    assert response.status_code == 401
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "unauthorized"
